# Replyloom

> Replyloom is a free, open-source (MIT), self-hosted WhatsApp CRM that runs entirely on Cloudflare (Workers, Durable Objects, D1, R2, Queues, Vectorize). It gives teams a shared WhatsApp inbox, multiple numbers per workspace, contacts and a deal pipeline, opt-in list broadcasts with anti-spam limits, scheduled messages, keyword auto-replies, webhooks, an API and an optional RAG AI support agent. It connects as a WhatsApp linked device through the unofficial Baileys library. It is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta, and numbers can be banned.
